schemaVersion.description: Manifest format version. Bumped only on breaking changes.

name.description: Catalog display name shown in the Wisp client when the user registers this repo.

homepage.description: Public URL — typically the repository page.

icon.description: Icon file path relative to manifest.json (e.g. 'icon.svg').

apps.description: Paths to app folders (each containing an app.json) relative to this manifest. The slug is read from app.json itself; the path's last segment must equal the slug.
